purpose: Replay every tidal memory-placement setting with eight lens-geometry starts so cap-placement and memory-placement effects are compared on equally robust roots.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the tidal memory-placement bridge fits.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing; only lens geometry, shear, centers, and source positions are reoptimized.
This is a numerical robustness replay on already inspected development clusters, not an external holdout.
All 27 settings are replayed because both cap and memory placement can cross image-root boundaries.
The mixed axisymmetric-galaxy/spherical-cluster closure remains a proxy rather than a common map-based tensor theory.
